definition_en: how many people or things there are

examples.supportive: The number of cars on the road grows every year.

items: A large ____ of students failed the test.

he_interference_note: אחרי the number of בא פועל ביחיד, ודוברי עברית כותבים The number of people are large.

definition_en: small in size

items: She has a ____ dog at home.

he_interference_note: בעברית 'קטן' אחד ל-little ול-small, ולכן דוברי עברית אומרים The dog is little כשהאנגלית הטבעית היא small.

definition_en: not much of something

items: He has ____ time for his family.
